subtitleNullable: Bounding box annotations for 7 waste classes
descriptionNullable:
Garbage Classification v2 — Bounding Box Annotated (384px)
===========================================================

A bounding-box annotated version of the "Garbage Classification v2"
dataset by Suman Kunwar.

Source      : https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/sumn2u/garbage-classification-v2/
Resolution  : standardized_384
Format      : YOLO (txt labels)
Classes     : 7  (biological, cardboard, glass, metal, paper, plastic, trash)

Excluded from the original 10-class source:
  battery, clothes, shoes
